column1: # The decompiler shows some string literals only as "the address of a shared string" (`&CX2State::`vftable'[95]`: IDA labelled the
# data around the string with the neighbouring vtable). The key is that expression; the value is the Lua name it must be.
# `~name` = inferred (not read from the binary): the registered class of the object plus the members the scripts use on the global
# of that name (tools/bindings.py, "Script-visible globals"). Add more keys here when the catalog still shows `<by address: ...>`.
